message:
Restore indexed compact score validation for controlled import qualification

Restore only the accepted two-line loop from #944 that was reversed while integrating #897; retain all split-origin propagation and surviving regression tests. The reversal is documented in a35b064d, but its intent is unknown.

Forty existing focused tests passed. Exact-product scope, YAML syntax, and diff checks passed. Local ESLint exited 137 under resource pressure and is not counted as a pass; hosted lint, main types, full existing unit tests, and release builds gate the experiment.

Register exact-source six-pair AB/BA import cohorts with unchanged correctness, identical-code controls, and separate memory gates. Experimental branch only; no complete-import gain claimed.
